1.w: My child, if you receive my words, and store up my commands inside yourself,

2.w: by making your ear attentive to wisdom and by turning your heart to understanding,

3.w: indeed, if you call out for discernment — shout loudly for understanding—

4.w: if you seek it like silver and search for it like hidden treasure,

5.w: then you will understand how to fear the Lord, and you will discover knowledge about God.

6.w: For the Lord gives wisdom, and from his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

7.w: He stores up effective counsel for the upright and is like a shield for those who live with integrity,

8.w: to guard the paths of the righteous and to protect the way of his pious ones.

9.w: Then you will understand righteousness and justice and equity—every good way.

10.w: For wisdom will enter your heart, and moral knowledge will be attractive to you.

11.w: Discretion will protect you; understanding will guard you

12.w: to deliver you from the way of the wicked, from those speaking perversity,

13.w: who leave the upright paths to walk on the dark ways,

14.w: who delight in doing evil; they rejoice in perverse evil,

15.w: whose paths are morally crooked and who are devious in their ways,

16.w: to deliver you from the adulterous woman, from the loose woman who has flattered you with her words,

17.w: who leaves the husband from her younger days and has ignored her marriage covenant made before God.

18.w: For she has set her house by death and her paths by the place of the departed spirits.

19.w: None who go in to her will return, nor will they reach the paths of life.

20.w: So you will walk in the way of good people and will keep on the paths of the righteous.

21.w: For the upright will reside in the land, and those with integrity will remain in it,

22.w: but the wicked will be removed from the land, and the treacherous will be torn away from it.
